source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Only the injection site and route, because federal vaccine record requirements do not include product identification.","B":"Only the administration date, because the manufacturer, lot number, and vaccine information record are unnecessary.","C":"Administration date, manufacturer and lot, administrator identity details, plus VIS edition and date it was provided.","D":"Only the vaccine trade name, because the administration date and identifying information are not required records."}}
source_row.rationale: Federal VIS recordkeeping requires documentation of administration date, manufacturer, lot number, administrator identity/address/title, VIS edition date, and date the VIS was provided; site and route may be documented clinically but are not the complete federal statutory set.
source_row.source_detail: Recordkeeping section under the National Childhood Vaccine Injury Act: record administration date, manufacturer, lot number, name/address/title of administrator, VIS edition date, and date VIS provided. CDC VIS instructions, page updated/reviewed May 29, 2025; rechecked 2026-08-15. Reviewed 2026-08-15.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Instructions for Using Vaccine Information Statements
source_row.stem: Under U.S. federal Vaccine Information Statement (VIS) recordkeeping requirements, which information must be documented in the permanent medical record after vaccination?
